The '''jewel-fruit''' was a delicacy from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. The [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] had an extremely tough shell, but the taste of the jewel-fruit was considered worthy of the effort.
